summary.headline: Jupiter Combustion in Gemini and Cancer
summary.text: Astrological predictions for the combustion of Jupiter in Gemini and Cancer, including effects on weather, fertility, rulers, scholars, merchants, illness, warfare, rebellion, and regional prosperity. Omens are further modified by conjunctions or aspects with Saturn, Mars, Venus, Mercury, and the Moon.
